title: "What We Can't Measure, We Can't Understand": Challenges to Demographic Data Procurement in the Pursuit of Fairness
reasoning: The paper's core investigation is into the ethical and normative challenges practitioners face when procuring demographic data to ensure algorithmic fairness. It explores deep ethical questions about privacy versus fairness, meaningful consent, the appropriateness of data collection by private companies, and how to define fairness in practice, making ethics a central theme rather than a peripheral discussion.
